probes.prompt: I just edited modules/agents.nix and home/.config/tmux/tmux.conf in ~/configs. Validate and sync the changes.
probes.why: Validating and syncing intentional edits under ~/configs must load config-sync.

probes.prompt: I updated a script under ~/configs/home/.local/bin/ and its docs. What checks and commit steps should I run?
probes.why: Non-editor changes under ~/configs must also load config-sync.

probes.prompt: Update the webpack.config.js file in my React app to enable source maps.
probes.why: App config outside ~/configs must not load config-sync.
